class.name: HEGoInputHandler
class.brief_description: Teaches HEGo to send another kind of Godot node to an HDA input.
class.description: HEGo itself handles paths, meshes, CSG shapes and graph inputs; the HEGo Strata and HEGo Terrain3D bridges add terrains. Another addon adds a kind by extending this class and giving it a [code]class_name[/code]: HEGo finds every global class that extends it, in the editor and in exported games alike, so installing that addon is all it takes. The dependency only runs one way. The extending addon names HEGo's classes; HEGo never names the addon's. Every method has a default that handles nothing, so a handler overrides only what it needs. Handlers are created once and reused, so keep per-input state in the input node [method sync] returns, not on the handler.

method.name: handles
method.description: Whether this handler turns [param node] into an input. Also decides whether the node counts as a compatible source when the panel or a cook resolves input paths.

method.name: sync
method.description: Creates or updates the HEGo input node for [param node]. [param existing_node] is the input node this HDA input used last cook, possibly of another type; reuse it when it fits. [param settings] is the input's settings dictionary from the input stash. During a cook it also carries [code]_cook[/code], the dictionary the host's [HEGoCookExtension]s and output handlers share ([member HEGoOutputContext.cook_state]), so a handler can pick up what an extension prepared for this cook or leave something for an output handler, and [code]_input_path[/code] ([constant HEGoInputNodes.INPUT_PATH_KEY]), the path the input was resolved from, which HEGo's own inputs send as [code]_hego_node_path[/code]. Returns [code]{ok: true, node}[/code], or [code]{ok: false, message}[/code] when the input could not be sent, which stops the cook with the previous output left in place.

method.name: claims_settings
method.description: Whether stored [param settings] were written for this handler's kind of input, even if the source node is currently missing. Keeps the handler's options in the panel, and its explicit-cook rule in force, while a referenced node is renamed or deleted.

method.name: requires_explicit_cook
method.description: Whether an input of this kind should wait for an explicit recook rather than recooking automatically whenever the panel changes it. [method HEGoNode3D.hego_requires_explicit_cook] asks this for every input row, so the node itself follows the rule too.

method.name: requires_strict_cook
method.description: Whether a cook with an input of this kind must be strict: any input that is missing, incompatible or fails to upload then fails the whole cook, rather than being skipped with a warning. For inputs whose result is published all-or-nothing, where a partial set of inputs would produce a wrong result rather than an incomplete one. See [method HEGoAssetAgent.sync_inputs].

method.name: create_settings_editor
method.description: An editor for this kind of input's settings, shown in the panel's input row, or null for none. HEGo creates one per input row. The control must provide [code]load_settings(settings: Dictionary)[/code], [code]get_settings() -> Dictionary[/code], which the panel merges into the input's stored settings, and [code]refresh(host: Node, nodes: Array)[/code], called with the row's current source nodes of this kind; and it must emit a [code]changed[/code] signal when the user edits it.
